relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that unilateral subcutaneous injection of BoNT/A into the whisker pad on the ipsilateral side of dIoN-CCI mice significantly attenuated bilateral mechanical pain hypersensitivity and anxiety-like behaviors induced by dIoN-CCI surgery in mice.

relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: The dIoN-CCI surgery significantly up-regulated the expression of TLR2, MyD88, CD11b (a microglia marker), IL-1β, TNF-α and IL-6 in the ipsilateral TNC in mice, and BoNT/A injection significantly inhibited the expression of these factors.

relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunostaining results confirmed that BoNT/A injection significantly inhibited the microglia activation in the ipsilateral TNC in dIoN-CCI mice.

relationships.subject: TLR2
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR2 deficiency also alleviated bilateral mechanical pain hypersensitivity and the up-regulation of MyD88 expression in the TNC of dIoN-CCI mice.

relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: the upregulation of mRNA expression of these proinflammatory factors was significantly decreased on day 5 after BoNT/A injection (day 19 after dIoN-CCI surgery) animals

key_findings: Unilateral BoNT/A injection attenuates bilateral trigeminal mechanical hypersensitivity and anxiety-like behavior in dIoN-CCI mice.
BoNT/A reduces TLR2, MyD88, microglial activation and IL-1β/TNF-α/IL-6 in the TNC; Tlr2 knockout mimics the analgesia.
